documents.text: The GO or the MPON confirms the invoice with payment advice to the MPOO or the MSPO , or the GO or the MPON rejects the invoice of the MPOO or the MSPO .
The MSPO reviews the dismissal .
Each morning , the files which have yet to be processed need to be checked , to make sure they are in order for the court hearing that day .
The INQ transmits the transaction data request to the IP .
The registration form as well as the print from the information system are stored in the patient file .
The new patient is added on the list of new notices .
One of the physicians will act as the second intaker .
As soon as this copy is received , the secretarial office will inform the second intaker and add the copy to the patient file .
During the first meeting , the patient is examined using a standard checklist which is filled out .
As soon as the meetings of the first and second intaker with the patient have taken place , the secretarial office puts the patient on the list of patients that reach this status .
She then checks the invoice items and notes the corresponding cost center at the ACME AG and the related cost center managers for each position on a separate form ( `` docket `` ) .
The docket and the copy of the invoice go to the internal mail together and are sent to the first cost center manager to the list .
He makes the commercial audit and issues the approval for payment .
The GO informs the MPOO about the registration confirmation of the MPON .
The GO informs the MPON about the failure of the overall transaction by deadline if after a maximum time limit no message of the MPON is present at the GO .
The first step is to determine contact details of potential customers .
Then we start calling the customer .
It is given either by a sales representative or by a pre-sales employee in case of a more technical presentation .
Usually they play a triple role : First they provide the company with procedural and financial advice , then they buy the issue , and finally they resell it to the public .
A member of the sales department can then reject or accept the order for a customized bike .
The storehouse immediately processes the part list of the order and checks the required quantity of each part .
This procedure is repeated for each item on the part list .
The customer data is received by customer service and based on this data a customer data object is entered into the CRM system .
If there are not any objections by the grid operator ( i.e . no supplier concurrence ) , customer service creates a CIS contract .
The confirmation message by the customer is therefore not absolutely necessary ( as it will count as accepted after 7 days in any way ) but it can speed up the switch process .
The process of winning a new customer ends here .
An electronic service then determines the significance of the customer based on information that has been collected during the history of the contractual relationship .

In case the customer is of certain significance which would affect the counter measures previously decided upon , the process goes back to re-prioritize these measures otherwise the process continues .
If a problem is detected this will be analyzed by Resource Provisioning and a trouble report is created .
Three alternative process paths may be taken .
Subsequently , the problem resolution report is created and then sent out to Customer Service .

Resource Provisioning has been on-hold and waiting for a restoration request but this must happen within 2 days after the status report was sent out , otherwise Resource Provisioning terminates the process .
Then a trouble-shooting report is created .

Then , two concurrent activities are triggered , i.e . i ) a report is created for the customer which details the current service performance and the resolution of the problem , and ii ) an SLA violation rebate is reported to Billing & Collections who will adjust the billing .
The GO verifies the deregistration .
The claims officer then writes a settlement recommendation .
If the claim is marked as Not OK , it is sent back to the claims officer and the recommendation is repeated .
Based on the outcome ( simple or complex claims ) , relevant forms are sent to the claimant .
If the forms provide all relevant details , the claim is registered in the Claims Management system , which ends the Claims Notification process .
The process of an Office Supply Request starts when any employee of the organization submits an office supply request .
If the request is asked to make a change then it is returned to the petitioner / employee who can review the comments for the change request .
In any case the system will send a notification to let the user know what the result was .
By the way , that is the second step .
Once production is scheduled to start , we receive a notice from the system and an employee takes care of the implementation .
The GO performs the equipment acquisition and / or equipment changes .
If someone is interested , he sends a note to the Manager .
An employee purchases a product or service he requires .
The treasurer checks that all the receipts have been submitted and match the items on the list .
If receipts are missing or do not match the report , he sends it back to the employee .
Within this unit , the Mail Clerk sorts the unopened mail into the various business areas .
Otherwise , the matter details ( types of action ) are captured and provided to the Cashier , who takes the applicable fees attached to the mail .
The MPOO sends a tender for the equipment takeover to the MPON .
The MSP denies the request of the GO or the MSP performs the measurement .
The MPO rejects the failure of the fault detector or the MPO confirms the failure of the fault detector .
The MPO fixes the fault at the measuring device .
The MPO will inform the MSP about the resolution of the interference .
The process starts when a customer submits a claim by sending in relevant documentation .
If the assessment is positive , a garage is phoned to authorise the repairs and the payment is scheduled ( in this order ) .
In any case ( whether the outcome is positive or negative ) , a letter is sent to the customer and the process is considered to be complete .
The MPON or the MPOO perform the final reading .
